The headworks consists of a Parshall flume flow meter, Headworks/Preliminary three automatic bar screens followed by two aerated grit Treatment chambers.

Primary Treatment
Primary treatment consists of two primary clarifiers that operate in parallel. The volume of each clarifying tank is 1.32 million gallons.
Trickling Filters: Secondary treatment is performed using two primary and two secondary aerobic trickling filters. Each of the primary trickling filters has a volume of 543,000 gallons.
Trickling Filters: Secondary treatment is performed using two primary and two secondary aerobic trickling filters. Each of the secondary trickling filters has a volume of 170,000 gallons.
